subject: Partner pipeline overlap triage — Nova Consulting / Enterprise accounts
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@nova-consult.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Keller <ben.keller@acme.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial overlap flag — Nova & Redwood named accounts

Hi Ava / Camila,

Quick one from the Nova side — as we ramp our co-sell program I pulled a list of accounts Nova plans to approach over the next 90 days and noticed a non-trivial overlap with a set of enterprise targets that Redwood is pursuing directly (we included Ben from the Acme account). I attached a working CSV with the overlap and some suggested owner tags ("Redwood direct", "Nova preferred", "Shared outreach").

Can we agree a triage approach? Our ask is: if Redwood has an active engaged opportunity (defined as HubSpot stage Proposal+ or recent meeting in last 30 days), Nova will standby and route through Redwood-led motions. For accounts where Redwood does not have an active play, Nova requests the right to run proof-of-value conversations.

I realize territory conflicts are sensitive — happy to sync briefly. Proposed next step: internal mapping call early next week to align rules of engagement + an updated overlap spreadsheet we can maintain.

Thanks,
Elaine
Partner Lead, Nova Consulting

Attachment: overlap_spreadsheet_v2.csv (CSV stub, 18KB)

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial overlap flag — Nova & Redwood named accounts

Thanks Elaine — and thanks Camila for looping in the GTM folks.

Marcus / Tessa — please see the Nova list (attached by Elaine). A few immediate asks:
- Marcus: can you confirm which of these are active Redwood opps (HubSpot stage and last contact date)?
- Camila: we need guidance on whether these accounts fall under regional ownership rules or product specialist ownership.
- Tessa: if we agree on gating rules (e.g., Proposal+ or meeting in last 30d), can Partner Ops enforce a partner outreach block in our partner portal?

I've penciled a 30-min sync for Thursday 11/5 — if that works for you I'll send the invite and include Elaine separately for the alignment portion.

Regards,
Ava Chen
Senior Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial overlap flag — Nova & Redwood named accounts

Ava — I pulled the ops report and annotated Elaine's CSV. Quick summary:
- Of the 27 accounts flagged, 11 are active opps (HubSpot stage: Proposal, Negotiation, Closed-Won in last 90d).
- 6 accounts are 'white space' for Redwood (no activity in CRM).
- 10 are low-touch trials / inbound POCs (recent but not Proposal stage).

Recommendation:
1) Auto-block Nova outreach to the 11 active opps until either deal moves to Closed-Won or partner-approved co-sell plan is signed.
2) Allow Nova to run PoVs on the 6 white-space accounts, but ask for pre-notification in the partner portal (simple intake form).
3) For the 10 low-touch accounts, enforce a 2-week cooling period and require SDR/AE notification.

I've attached a regional mapping slide that ties the accounts to AE owners and suggested routing. If we're aligned I can push the block rules to Partner Ops and update HubSpot owner tags.

Attachment: region_account_mapping_slides.pdf (PDF stub, 320KB)

- Marcus

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial overlap flag — Nova & Redwood named accounts

Agree with Marcus' framework. A few operational notes from GTM:
- Territory rule: regional AEs retain ownership for all accounts > $250k ARR. Those are auto-protected.
- ISV / Systems integrator partner requests for PoV need an AE sponsor and a signed MOU (2-page) for co-sell tracking.
- For "shared outreach" cases, we'll create joint playbooks (1-pagers) and require a single point of contact from Nova and the AE.

Tessa: please treat Marcus' "auto-block" list as priority for Partner Ops to implement. Also add a HubSpot deal tag "partner-paused" so reps see the gating reason.

Camila
VP, Strategic Partnerships

From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@nova-consult.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial overlap flag — Nova & Redwood named accounts

Thanks everyone — this is very helpful and fair. Two quick asks from Nova:
1) Can we get a short MOU template (2 pages) that references the PR & crediting for pipeline? If you have a canonical one we can sign quickly.
2) For the 6 white-space accounts Nova will start outreach next week. We'll use the intake form you mentioned and cc the AE.

We appreciate the clarity — happy to pilot the joint playbooks on two accounts in EMEA (we'll propose names in the intake form).

Best,
Elaine

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@nova-consult.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial overlap flag — Nova & Redwood named accounts

Great — next steps and owners: 
- Camila to circulate 2-page MOU template by EOD Wednesday 11/11. (Camila)
- Marcus / Partner Ops to implement auto-block + "partner-paused" HubSpot tag by 11/12. (Marcus / Tessa)
- Nova to submit intake forms for the 6 white-space accounts and propose 2 EMEA pilot accounts by 11/12. (Elaine)
- Ava to update partner portal mapping and publish the overlap spreadsheet link to shared drive. (Ava)

I'll follow up once Partner Ops confirms the rules are live. Thanks all for the quick alignment.

Cheers,
Ava
Senior Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
